The presence of two distinct targets for Cathepsin B suggests that Hadacidin may influence the activity of this enzyme in different ways, potentially through different molecular mechanisms. The evidence is consistent with the idea that Hadacidin could modulate the activity of Serine protease inhibitor Kazal-type 6, though the exact nature of this interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
